items.difficulty_reason: Directedness of the system of coherent submodules is verified directly (the image of G plus H is coherent and contains both); the statement is then transported along the groupoid presentation QCoh(X) = QCoh(U,R,s,t,c) to the cited Groupoids in Spaces lemma, whose hypotheses are checked in a final paragraph (U Noetherian from the smooth-local definition, s,t smooth quasi-separated quasi-compact, R Noetherian).
